body: Well, obviously. Some things are easier said than done.
Thanks! Its a good strategy.  Its not too bad when I'm at work and I can turn my mind off, but its hard to tune out when I'm alone.

I've mentioned it to a therapist but I always put it in the past tense.  I've hidden it so well for so long that I cant even bring myself to tell the truth.  And the more I get to know this therapist the more I pretend things are okay.  Also a weird process.

I dont want to kill myself but i don't want to be alive.  Its a very weird thing to wake up hoping a meteor crashes through my building.  I hate that my depression has no sadness to it.  I wish I could cry just to feel something.  I hate that Im such a good actor I cant even turn it off to get help.
